problems.title: The diary is a daily puzzle.
problems.text: Working out which engineer goes where is done by hand each morning, and it falls apart with the first emergency call.

problems.title: No margin per job.
problems.text: The job gets done and invoiced, but nobody knows what it actually made.

problems.title: No idea what each engineer brings in.
problems.text: Without that number, you can't tell who is making money and who is costing it.

problems.title: Customers are never sold to again.
problems.text: No yearly service reminder, no maintenance plan, nothing that builds loyalty. Each customer is a one-off.

problems.title: A day a week lost to admin.
problems.text: Heating business owners report about seven hours a week on paperwork, and those surveyed already use job software.

problems.title: Thousands owed.
problems.text: Tradespeople are owed £5,901 on average in unpaid invoices.

usualFix: ServiceM8, Commusoft and the rest hold your diary, but they don't plan it. They record a job, but they don't tell you its margin. And they never go back to a customer a year later. Those gaps are where the money leaks. We close them on top of what you already use, so you don't have to change system.

faqs.q: Do we have to stop using ServiceM8 or Commusoft?
faqs.a: No. We work on top of what you already use.

faqs.q: How do you bring past customers back?
faqs.a: We work out which of your past customers are worth contacting, and send each one a personal message with a reason to book. Every message has a way to opt out.

faqs.q: Will it reply to customers without us checking?
faqs.a: You choose. Most clients approve every reply at first, then let it run once they trust it.

faqs.q: How soon will we see money come back?
faqs.a: One client recovered £18k in its first 90 days.
We agree one fixed price before any work starts.
